name: invented2
idea: The existing stack covers constant strides and dense spatial regions, but the traces show 84-93% of accesses follow a repeating (delta_prev, delta_curr) history pattern that no fixed-delta prefetcher can exploit. I implement a lightweight per-PC delta-pair predictor: it learns the most frequent (prev_delta, curr_delta) pair per PC and emits the next predicted delta, capturing the irregular/pointer
